title: Gripping device for gripping ferromagnetic objects

features.item: A housing containing a displaceable magnet and pole shoes with workpiece contact surfaces.
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph p0013) The reference describes a gripping device (housing) with a displaceable magnet and a pole shoe with a contact surface for workpieces.

features.item: A magnet displaceable along a direction between a gripping position and a release position.
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph p0013) The reference explicitly states that the magnet is displaceable between an active (gripping) and passive (release) position.

features.item: Pole shoes attached to the housing, each with a workpiece contact surface.
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph p0013) The reference describes a pole shoe with a contact surface for the workpieces.

features.item: Pole shoes designed to guide a magnetic field portion to the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The pole shoe's design with varying wall thickness is described as guiding the magnetic field.

features.item: A workpiece contact surface defining a contact surface angle of 170° to 190° with the displacement direction.
features.note: The reference does not specify any angle for the workpiece contact surface relative to the displacement direction.

features.item: A magnetic gripper with housing, displaceable magnet, and pole shoes where contact surface angle is 170° to 190° relative to displacement direction.
features.note: The reference describes a magnetic gripper with a displaceable magnet and pole shoes, but does not specify the contact surface angle relative to the displacement direction.

features.item: A magnetic gripper system with a magnetic gripper and ferromagnetic workpiece, where magnet in gripping position presses workpiece against contact surfaces by magnetic force.
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph p0002) The reference describes the gripper's function as gripping and lifting ferromagnetic objects, implying magnetic force holds the workpiece against contact surfaces.

features.item: Housing extending along a longitudinal axis with displacement direction parallel to that axis.
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The magnet is displaceable along a longitudinal axis, which implies the housing also extends along this axis.

features.item: Pole shoes with an active structure for directing the magnetic field portion.
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The varying wall thickness of the pole shoe is described as a design feature to direct the magnetic field.

features.item: An active structure with a bevel defining a bevel angle of 5° to 85° with the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph p0006) The reference mentions rounded or chamfered edges (bevels) on the pole shoe, but does not specify an angle range.

features.item: An active structure with multiple projections for directing magnetic field and forming the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: The reference does not describe multiple projections on the pole shoe for directing the magnetic field or forming the contact surface.

features.item: Adjacent first and second projections with a recess between them, recess depth or length deviating by at most 25% from projection length.
features.note: The reference does not describe projections or recesses with specific dimensional relationships.

features.item: A positioning device on the magnetic gripper for positioning the ferromagnetic workpiece on the contact surface.
features.note: The reference does not describe any specific positioning device for the workpiece.

features.item: First and second pole shoes where the magnet in gripping position makes the first pole shoe act as north pole and second as south pole.
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes the magnet having a magnetization direction from a north pole to a south pole, and the pole shoe having thicker walls in the area of these poles, implying the pole shoe guides these poles to the workpiece.

features.item: A magnet displaceable electrically, pneumatically, or mechanically between gripping and release positions.
features.quote: Zweckmäßigerweise kann der Aktor als pneumatische Kolben-Zylinder-Einheit oder als elektrischer Antrieb ausgebildet sein.
features.note: The reference explicitly states that the actuator can be a pneumatic piston-cylinder unit or an electric drive, both of which displace the magnet.
features.refuted: The quote describes an actuator (Aktor) as a pneumatic piston-cylinder unit or electric drive, not a magnet that is displaceable.

features.item: A position sensor detecting gripping position and/or release position, or a workpiece sensor detecting the ferromagnetic workpiece.
features.quote: Das Gehäuse kann an seiner Mantelfläche Nuten zur Befestigung, beispielsweise von Sensoren, aufweisen.
features.note: The reference mentions grooves for attaching sensors, implying sensors could be used, but does not explicitly state a position or workpiece sensor.

features.item: Housing with a receptacle for receiving a workpiece sensor and/or a supply line.
features.quote: Das Gehäuse kann an seiner Mantelfläche Nuten zur Befestigung, beispielsweise von Sensoren, aufweisen.
features.note: The reference mentions grooves for attaching sensors, which could act as a receptacle, but does not explicitly mention a receptacle for supply lines.

features.item: A manipulator interface on the magnetic gripper for attaching to a manipulator.
features.note: The reference does not describe any manipulator interface.

features.item: Housing portion designed to suppress magnetic field escape, or a shielding device to at least partially prevent magnetic field escape.
features.quote: Hiermit ist sichergestellt, dass insbesondere in der Passivstellung keine oder nur vernachlässigbar geringe Magnetkräfte auf den Polschuh einwirken.
features.note: The reference mentions a non-ferromagnetic intermediate plate to ensure negligible magnetic forces on the pole shoe in the passive state, which implies some control over magnetic field, but not explicit shielding of escape.

features.item: At least one projection with length deviating by at most 25% from the thickness of the ferromagnetic workpiece.
features.note: The reference does not describe projections with specific dimensional relationships to workpiece thickness.

features.item: A receptacle in the form of a groove in the housing.
features.quote: Das Gehäuse 46 kann Nuten 48 zur Befestigung von Komponenten, beispielsweise von Sensoren, aufweisen.
features.note: The reference explicitly mentions grooves (Nuten) in the housing for attaching components.
features.refuted: The quote describes grooves for fastening components like sensors, not a receptacle in the form of a groove.

features.item: A bevel angle of 15° to 75° between the active structure bevel and the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph p0006) The reference mentions rounded or chamfered edges (bevels) on the pole shoe, but does not specify an angle range.

features.item: A bevel angle of 40° to 60° between the active structure bevel and the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: The reference mentions rounded or chamfered edges but does not specify any angle range for them.
